# Open Source Together

> Personal site of Courtney Robertson: open source, IndieWeb, and community.
> Posts are published here first and syndicated elsewhere (POSSE).

## Content

- [All posts](https://opensourcetogether.dev/posts): every post kind — articles, notes, bookmarks, replies, and more — newest first
- [Blogroll](https://opensourcetogether.dev/blogroll): people and sites I follow, with XFN relationship metadata
- [RSS feed](https://opensourcetogether.dev/rss.xml): the 20 most recent posts

## Machine-readable surfaces

- [Sitemap](https://opensourcetogether.dev/sitemap.xml)
- Posts are marked up as microformats2 h-entry; the blogroll is an h-feed of h-cards
- IndieWeb endpoints: /webmention (Webmention), /micropub (Micropub), /indieauth/metadata (IndieAuth server metadata)
